messages:
Nina: Heads up vendor (Zenith) just pushed 30/50 H200s into next window. we only get 20 this week. can we source spot for the 10 shortfall?
Rahul: ETA on backfill from Zenith?
Procurement: Zenith says backfill 18-25 days. they offered 10 loaners on short-term loan but they require RMA reference 'LN-4123' and a return manifest within 7 days. also flagged customs HS code mismatch risk for SEA-FRA lanes.
Nina: loaners ok if shipping cost reasonable. any depot capacity for immediate intake? @Lucas
Lucas: FRA depot has 8 open cold-chain slots today, BER has 6 tomorrow. note: FRA inspectors require manifest with HS codes and photos before acceptance.
Finance: quick flag 1: air vs sea cost delta. air: ~$28k per AWB (up to 8 units), sea: ~$3k per container but 14-21 day transit. need decision by EOD to keep allocation window.
infra-bot: ALERT: capacity-forecast: prod-train pool projected to hit 60% within 48h without 10 units. render-batch affected. throttling to non-critical jobs scheduled.
Rahul: tradeoff: accept loaners (10 units) via overnight air at vendor expense? vendor says they can cover freight for loaners if we accept as DOA-risk-managed via RMA.
Procurement: vendor covers loaner freight but requires us to initiate RMA on arrival if any unit fails initial smoke test. RMA window: 72h for smoke test. loaners flagged as "non-retail" and need separate return AWB TL-4123-R.
Nina: what's customs exposure? HS mismatch means potential hold and duties. carrier can pre-clear with docs but fee applies.
CarrierBot: Carrier note: pre-clear fee $1,100 per AWB. if we consolidate 8 units in one AWB, fee is $1,100 total. suggested routing: 8 -> FRA (AWB ZEN-A1), 2 -> BER (AWB ZEN-B1). pickup earliest tonight 22:00 if labels uploaded.
Procurement: shipping plan draft: 
```
Loaner AWB ZEN-A1: 8 units -> FRA
Loaner AWB ZEN-B1: 2 units -> BER
RMA ref: LN-4123
Vendor pays loaner freight + return AWB on confirmed DOA
```
Lucas: reserve FRA 8 slots, BER 6 slots. crate pickup scheduled 21:30. warehouse wants final manifest by 20:00.
Finance: if vendor covers loaner freight, incremental cost limited to customs pre-clear and handling: estimate $1,600 total => ~$160/unit. sign-off ok for provisional.
Rahul: runbook tweak: if >1 DOA per AWB, auto-escalate to vendor credit + immediate replacement air. add perf tag to the RMA so ops can track.
Nina: ack. Procurement, upload final manifest and ask vendor for loaner serial list + photos. include HS code confirmed string.
Procurement: will upload manifest and label tonight. adding HS code: 8471.80 (compute equipment) as vendor insisted. also requesting vendor photo pack.
infra-bot: NOTE: after loaner routing, capacity-forecast improves to 85% for prod-train for 9 days.
Nina: ok go ahead. action items: 1) Procurement upload manifest & labels (Procurement) 2) Carrier pickup confirmation (CarrierBot) 3) FRA/BER slot reserve (Lucas) 4) Finance finalize customs pre-clear pay (Finance). I'll post follow-ups in #eng-infra. :thumbsup:
CarrierBot: Pickup tentatively scheduled for 22:00 once labels live. AWB templates: ZEN-A1, ZEN-B1.
Nina: thanks. closing thread after pickup confirmation.
